AbstractText.Label: OBJECTIVES
AbstractText.content: The aim of the present study was to validate the Korean-version MSAS-SF in patients with gynecologic cancer.

AbstractText.Label: METHODS
AbstractText.content: We translated the MSAS-SF into Korean and 175 gynecologic cancer inpatients completed the MSAS-SF, Functional Assessment Cancer Therapy-General (FACT-G), and gathered demographic and clinical data and Karnofsky Performace Status (KPS). Reliability was assessed for internal consistency with Cronbach's alpha coefficient. Pearson's correlation coefficient was calculated between the MSAS-SF and FACT-G subscales for convergent validity. T-test analysis was used to compare differences in MSAS-SF subscales by cancer stage and KPS for discriminant validity.

AbstractText.Label: RESULTS
AbstractText.content: The Cronbach alpha coefficients for the MSAS-SF subscales ranged from 0.80 to 0.91. The Korean-version MSAS-SF subscales showed convergent validity with FACT-G subscales. The correlation coefficients were -0.640 (P < 0.001) and -0.628 (P < 0.001) for GDI (global distress index) and total MSAS score with FACT-G total score. The scores of MSAS-SF subscales showed appropriate differences by cancer stage and KPS.

AbstractText.Label: CONCLUSIONS
AbstractText.content: The Korean-version MSAS-SF is a valid tool for the reliable assessment of patients with gynecologic cancer in Korea.
